answer.summary: No prior evidence supports non-feature-based memory coherence, continuity, or self-evaluation in agent behavior under controlled, invariant conditions.
answer.content: Across all inspected sections of Kumar et al., 2024, no explicit or implicit indicators of internal memory mechanisms beyond external validation or feature vectors were found. Observed behaviors remain tied to structured inputs and external cues, with no reported self-monitoring, temporal stability, or user-perceived consistency in multi-turn interactions without memory support structures. The absence of non-feature-based memory indicators confirms current limitations in empirical documentation of agent memory autonomy and continuity beyond external scaffolding.
